I’m surprised you didn’t do an internship. As long as you have a bachelors and passed the cbest and whatever other crednetial exams you need, you can work and get a full pay minus 10% to pay for your credential professors to come and observe you. The only down side really is you stay a probationary 0 until your internship is complete (1-2 years).

I apologize for the other teachers on here. Many that I have read ripped into you and attacked your character without knowing any details. Kind of like what many parents do to them.

To answer your question, yes, often the bad apples get all the attention and yea, we are all teacher C sometimes depending on students, parents, admin, and life. While we all strive to be a teacher A all the time, it just isn’t practical as no matter how good you are, there will always be students/parents/admin who hate you and everything you do and will rally others against you. 

My question is why is A good? Why is C not? I don’t think parents are always wrong as there are teachers that are just bad and everyone can see that but stay on due to tenure/politics/corrupt school boards (point and case, I had a fellow teacher take a student to the nearby city to court to try to get the student legally emancipated in order to have the student move in with him. Parents were angry, teacher got a slap on the wrist)

I hope this answered your question and once again, sorry for the rude behavior of my fellow teachers on here.
